title: Reticulum
summary: Contacts, messages and connections for the Reticulum network.
description: Write direct messages to contacts and see whether they arrived. Switch on the ways your deck can reach others: Wi-Fi / LAN, the internet, a LoRa radio (RNode) and more. Every connection starts off; nothing is sent until you allow it and press Send. Includes the background service (bundled Reticulum and LXMF, started when you open the app). Radio and serial ports need the dialout group; their settings and legality are yours.
depends: python3 (>= 3.10), python3-cryptography, python3-serial, libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0
